summary.headline: AceVector H1 FY27 revenue rose 17% YoY to INR285.5 crore, while Q2 adjusted EBITDA loss widened to INR8.6 crore from INR2.2 crore.
summary.overview: AceVector reported H1 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations of INR285.5 crore, up 17% YoY, and Q2 FY27 revenue of INR151.2 crore, up 17% from INR129.3 crore. Q2 adjusted EBITDA loss was INR8.6 crore versus a INR2.2 crore loss in Q2 FY26, but it narrowed more than 50% from about INR18.3 crore in Q1 despite festive marketing spend. Snapdeal's overall NMV growth slowed to 10% in H1 as festive timing shifted from Q2 to Q3, while fashion NMV grew 31%. Unicommerce revenue grew 15% to INR110.4 crore, with management guiding to a return to higher profitability in H2 FY27.

financial_highlights.change: vs loss of INR2.2 crore in Q2 FY26; narrowed from loss of about INR18.3 crore in Q1 FY27

financial_highlights.value: Growth 31% YoY; fashion share of business about 68%+
financial_highlights.change: fashion share up from 57% in H1 FY26
delivered units up 16%; app-delivered units up 23%

segments.name: Snapdeal (value fashion marketplace)
segments.commentary: Fashion NMV up 31% YoY in H1 and fashion now about 68%+ of business; overall NMV up 10% and delivered units up 16%, with October first 15 days units up 60% YoY. Contribution margin about 10% of NMV on ~INR400 ASP, giving ~INR40 unit contribution; zero commission to sellers, asset-light and zero-inventory.

segments.name: Unicommerce (SaaS enablement)
segments.commentary: H1 revenue INR110.4 crore, up 15% YoY, with usage-linked per-transaction pricing. Management has stepped up investment over three quarters, which moderated adjusted EBITDA; guides 15%+ growth in Uniware and 20%+ growth in Shipway from Q4 FY27.

guidance_outlook: Unicommerce expects 15%+ growth in Uniware and 20%+ growth in Shipway from Q4 FY27 onwards.
Pace of incremental investment at Unicommerce expected to moderate in H2 FY27, with higher profitability and stronger operating leverage targeted in H2 FY27.
Snapdeal expects its overall business to continue growing in the 30s (%) going forward, per Achint Setia, and the fashion/home/beauty category mix to stay broadly similar.
Full picture on Q2 plus Q3 festive impact to come with Q3 results; no quantified festive impact given.
capex_capacity: Management described the model as asset-light with very low infrastructure requirement; no capex or capacity figures were given.
Snapdeal is zero-inventory and runs on third-party logistics; Unicommerce is a pure SaaS model with no infrastructure investment disclosed.
demand_pricing: Snapdeal fashion NMV up 31% YoY in H1; active fashion listings up 91% YoY to about 95 lakh; active sellers doubled YoY.
Repeat volumes about 80% of Snapdeal volumes; top 10% customers buy 17 times a year vs 13 times in FY24; payback on new customers 12 to 18 months.
Festive season shifted from Q2 last year to mainly Q3 this year, which dampened Q2 NMV growth; October first 15 days delivered unit growth of 60% YoY.
Snapdeal targets INR300 to INR800 value segment; Gen Z made up nearly two-thirds of new customers in H1; 80% of sales from outside metros.
Unicommerce serves 8,500+ clients across Uniware, Shipway and ConvertWay, including Fabindia, Hidesign, Lenskart and Mamaearth, with presence in six countries outside India.

qa_highlights.question: How are CAC and cohort payback evolving for new app customers, and what are repeat purchase economics?
qa_highlights.answer: Achint Setia said repeat volumes are about 80%+ of Snapdeal volumes, repeat frequency rose 11% YoY in H1, and CAC is healthy with payback typically 12 to 18 months.

qa_highlights.question: Which AI initiatives show measurable outcomes versus early-stage investment?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited conversational search at 1 crore+ monthly intent-driven searches, Snap&Shop image search at 4 crore+ monthly discovery views, 81%+ of orders influenced by AI discovery, 89% of support queries resolved by SIA AI, and 90% cut in seller onboarding time.

qa_highlights.question: Is Snapdeal shifting strategy to focus mainly on fashion, with BPC and home taking a backseat?
qa_highlights.answer: Achint Setia said fashion share rose from 57% in H1 FY26 to 68%+ in H1 FY27, the three core categories (fashion, home, beauty and personal care) should keep a similar mix, and the overall business should keep growing in the 30s.

qa_highlights.question: What was the quantified impact of the festive shift to Q3 on overall growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to quantify and said Q2 and Q3 should be viewed together once Q3 results are out; early indicators show 60% YoY volume growth in the first 15 days of October.

risks_watch: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened YoY to INR8.6 crore in Q2 FY27 from INR2.2 crore; H2 profitability recovery depends on lower Unicommerce investment and festive leverage.
Snapdeal overall NMV growth (10%) lagged delivered units (16%), implying lower average order value; monitor NMV growth in Q3 FY27.
Unicommerce growth guidance of 15%+ (Uniware) and 20%+ (Shipway) starts only from Q4 FY27; H1 growth was 15%.
Festive timing shift makes Q2 and Q3 comparisons noisy; management has not quantified the impact.

Snapdeal's proposition rests on unbranded value fashion, and management acknowledged that a consumer trust gap needs AI-led fit and discovery tools; no data on rural penetration or repeat trends by region was given.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on AI initiatives, fashion growth and the October start, but cautious on near-term profitability, with the festive shift used to explain moderated H1 growth. Management avoided quantifying the festive impact and deferred to Q3 results.
key_quotes: Our focus on profitability is visible sequentially.
We also expect the pace of incremental investments to moderate in the second half of the year, ensuring that we demonstrate higher profitability and stronger operating leverage in H2 FY27.
Our top customers buy 17 times a year, and that has also grown from 13 times a year a couple of years ago.
We expect the portfolio of this category share to be largely in the same ballpark as it is today, and the overall business we expect to continue grow in 30s as we move forward.

growth.why: Management guides Snapdeal overall business to grow in the 30s% and Uniware/Shipway to grow 15%+/20%+ from Q4 FY27, backed by demand indicators (October first-15-day units +60%, active fashion listings +91%) and a targeted H2 FY27 profitability recovery at Unicommerce, but no capacity, orders or contract figures were given, and the Q2 EBITDA loss was not quantified as a growth rate.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to INR8.6 crore from about INR18.3 crore in Q1, and management targets higher Unicommerce profitability and operating leverage in H2 FY27 as incremental investment moderates, though festive spend weighed on Q2.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management expects Snapdeal to keep growing in the 30s%, delivered units rose 16% in H1 with October first-15-day units up 60% YoY, and active fashion listings grew 91% to about 95 lakh.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Model is asset-light and zero-inventory with no capex or capacity figures given, and Unicommerce is pure SaaS with no infrastructure investment disclosed, so no capex trigger is evident.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Snapdeal guides to 30s% growth and Unicommerce to 15%+ Uniware and 20%+ Shipway from Q4 FY27, while H1 Unicommerce growth was only 15% and Snapdeal overall NMV grew 10%, so an upgrade depends on festive-shift catch-up in Q3.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Snapdeal overall NMV grew only 10% in H1 versus 16% delivered-unit growth, implying lower AOV, and the festive shift to Q3 makes Q2/Q3 comparisons noisy with no quantified impact given.

rows.label: Unicommerce profitability recovery in H2 FY27
rows.why: Management guides moderating incremental investment and stronger operating leverage at Unicommerce in H2 FY27, after three quarters of stepped-up spend that moderated adjusted EBITDA; H1 revenue grew 15% to INR110.4 crore.

rows.label: Snapdeal fashion momentum into festive Q3
rows.why: Fashion NMV grew 31% in H1, fashion share rose to about 68% from 57%, and October first-15-day delivered units grew 60% YoY, with festive volume shifting into Q3.

rows.label: Snapdeal AOV and NMV conversion
rows.why: Overall NMV grew 10% against 16% delivered-unit growth, so average order value is lagging and needs to recover to convert volume into NMV growth.

tone.note: Management was confident on AI initiatives, fashion growth and the October start, and cautious on near-term profitability; analysts pressed on CAC and payback, and on the festive-shift impact, which management declined to quantify and deferred to Q3 results.
